scripts.test: bddgen --tags "not @wip" && rm -rf blob-report && (PW_BLOB=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE_NAME=parallel.zip playwright test --project=parallel --project=role-coordinator --project=role-participant --project=matrix --pass-with-no-tests; a=$?; PW_BLOB=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE_NAME=exclusive.zip playwright test --project=exclusive --pass-with-no-tests; b=$?; playwright merge-reports --reporter=html ./blob-report; exit $((a || b)))
scripts.test:smoke: bddgen --tags "@smoke and not @wip" && rm -rf blob-report && (PW_BLOB=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE_NAME=parallel.zip playwright test --project=parallel --project=role-coordinator --project=role-participant --project=matrix --pass-with-no-tests; a=$?; PW_BLOB=1 PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_FILE_NAME=exclusive.zip playwright test --project=exclusive --pass-with-no-tests; b=$?; playwright merge-reports --reporter=html ./blob-report; exit $((a || b)))
